capabilities: Scan the vault for broken internal wikilinks
Classify broken links into near-misses and planned notes
Suggest the existing note a near-miss link probably meant
Flag planned notes linked from multiple notes as recurring
Export planned notes as a Markdown checklist
extras: Also available as a browser version at vault-link-checker.vercel.app; the README notes the plugin has not yet been accepted into the community plugin directory and can be installed via BRAT or manually.
intentEvidence: Plugins like Dangling links and Find orphaned files and broken links answer "which links are broken?"
problem: Obsidian shows broken links as a flat list, without telling you whether a link is a fixable typo pointing at an existing note or an idea you never wrote.

summary: Link checker that scans the vault for broken internal links and sorts them into near-misses with suggested fixes and planned notes.
